name: content-inventory-audit
description: Inventory and audit existing content (pages, articles, media, components) for a site or product. Produces structured inventory with metadata (URL, title, type, last-updated, author, status, tags, word count, media count), quality audit (accuracy, freshness, completeness, relevance, findability), gap analysis vs user needs, and per-item recommended action (keep / update / merge / delete / migrate). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
